benefits.title: Personal Perks (Big Spend Bonus)
benefits.description: Spend $15,000 in a year and earn one Personal Perk from Virgin Atlantic, Virgin Hotels or Virgin Voyages. Spend $30,000 and select one more. Maximum two per cardholder year. Options include: companion seat voucher or cabin upgrade voucher (Virgin Atlantic), one free night stay or priority room upgrade (Virgin Hotels), up to $300 bar tab credit or Blue Extras perks package (Virgin Voyages).

benefits.title: Virgin Atlantic Flying Club Tier Points
benefits.description: Earn 25 Tier Points when you spend $2,500 in a month. Maximum 50 Tier Points per month.

benefits.title: Third Night Free at Virgin Hotels
benefits.description: Book two nights and get your third night free at participating Virgin Hotels properties once a year.

benefits.title: Cards for Friends & Family
benefits.description: Earn 2,500 Virgin Points when you add a loved one as an additional account user, up to 10,000 points total.

benefits.title: Anniversary Points Boost
benefits.description: Earn 5,000 Virgin Points every year upon card renewal. Posts to Rewards Program Account within 1-2 Statement Periods if account is open and in good standing.

benefits.title: No Foreign Transaction Fees
benefits.description: No foreign transaction fees. Travel with no foreign transaction fees.

benefits.title: Virgin Points Don't Expire
benefits.description: Virgin Points don't expire. Points kept on ice until you're ready to spend them.

benefits.title: Mastercard Global Service
benefits.description: Get emergency assistance virtually anytime, anywhere and in any language. Report a lost or stolen card, get an emergency replacement and more. 24/7 assistance at 1-800-MASTERCARD.

benefits.title: Mastercard ID Theft Protection
benefits.description: Detects and helps quickly resolve ID theft events, 24/7. Provided by Iris Powered by Generali.

benefits.title: Mastercard Priceless Experiences
